title: Test real content and zoom
summary: A responsive layout needs testing with real words and larger text.
introduction: A responsive layout needs testing with real words and larger text. Your task: Test one page with a long title at 200% zoom.
learningObjectives: Test one page with a long title at 200% zoom.
Explain the example for test real content and zoom

blocks.text: A responsive layout needs testing with real words and larger text. A design can fit empty boxes yet fail when a title gets long.
Use the runnable HTML examples here, then resize a local browser page or its device preview. The CSS examples are inside each small page, so no framework is required.

blocks.code:
Check a narrow phone-sized width.
Check a wide desktop width.
Try a very long title.
Zoom the page to 200%.
Use Tab through every control.
Check that reading does not need sideways scrolling.
blocks.title: Test real content and zoom

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: A long title checks whether text can wrap without hiding content.
A 200% zoom test checks whether the layout still works when the reader needs more space.

blocks.text: You learn which part needs a flexible size, a wrap rule or more space.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not test only one screenshot size. Content and user settings can change the layout.
